objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (19 November 2026) on BREAK-EDDIES-20261119-001#1: build the map with first-round junctions as points, admitting the cluster rule's excluded overlap (a group of three sharing two knots with another block) as a loop of length two; build it on the 36 break-shape eddies with W = y^2(1 + y) and stop when it predicts their W, or at a start where it cannot. Serves G17.
status: Complete 2026-11-19 (Successful, 4 of 4 held; refereed R1, confirmed): the stop rule's second case. The junction map cannot predict the break shapes' loops (the short loops first claimed were withdrawn by BREAK-EDDIES' referee): the overlap is not a loop of length two (a second lap reaches the same junction), so the map is right one round and wrong the next wherever the overlap stands, and exact where it does not; a different object (a transfer between kinds of junction) is needed.
stop_rule: Stop when the map predicts the 36 starts' W, or at a start where it cannot.
title: A map that sees loops through first-round junctions
